design_principles.terminal_rule: If the eight-state aligned rung does not reach the frozen numerical comparator, P3 stops. Any state count above eight requires a new prospective phase.

physical_information_target: exact P2 storage anchors at 0-20, 0-40 and 0-80 cm
downward propagation of surface forcing through the upper profile
vertical moisture-profile information without reallocating states toward the lower boundary

S6.derivation: Add a 0-10 cm surface discriminator and bisect the 40-80 cm propagation interval at 60 cm while preserving all P2 anchors.

S8.derivation: Further resolve the 20-60 cm transmission zone at 10 cm support while retaining 60-80 cm as the deepest upper-profile transition state and leaving 80-160 cm intentionally coarse.

physical_information_target: capillary response and boundary reversal propagation
increasing hydraulic-state density toward the lower boundary

G6.derivation: Bisect 80-120 cm and the bottom-most 140-160 cm interval, preserving P2 anchors and increasing bottom-adjacent resolution.

G8.derivation: Bisect 120-140 cm and then the remaining bottom-most 150-160 cm interval, producing progressive refinement toward the boundary while preserving all earlier anchors.

comparison_rules.uniform_role: Distinguish gain from additional state count from gain due to purpose-aligned placement. Uniform comparators do not define the purpose-specific minimum.
comparison_rules.cross_purpose_role: Diagnostic only; never used to alter boundaries or primary admission.
